div.div:
مُصَمَّدٌ applied to a house, or tent, (بَيْتٌ, S) repaired to [repeatedly, or frequently, or by many persons, as is indicated by the teshdeed, though only expl. as] syn. with مَقْصُودٌ. (S, K.) ＝
-A2- Also A hard thing; in which is no softness, or fragility. (K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
